name: beautywallet-android
description: BeautyWallet Android app: a Capacitor shell that opens https://beautywallet.liara.run/legacy/ and adds offline, on-time routine reminders (local notifications).

scripts.prepare-android: npx cap add android && npx capacitor-assets generate --android --iconBackgroundColor '#f6f8ff' --iconBackgroundColorDark '#f6f8ff' --splashBackgroundColor '#f6f8ff' --splashBackgroundColorDark '#f6f8ff' && node patch-android.mjs && npx cap sync android
